## Description
Briefly describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or adapter
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes (`pnpm run build`)
- [ ] Code formatted (`pnpm run format`)
- [ ] Conventional Commit format used in commit messages
- [ ] Documentation updated if relevant
